About

An engineer the heavy industries call first

For more than thirty years, Kamal Shah has worked at the point where metallurgy meets production — helping refineries, petrochemical complexes, power plants and steel mills choose the right welding consumables, qualify the right procedures, and keep critical joints sound for decades of service.

Since 2016 he has headed Application Engineering for India at voestalpine Böhler Welding, the Austrian group's global welding business, while also managing its Global Industry Key Accounts for petrochemical & chemical processing and thermal power. Before that he built the company's pipeline and petrochemical segment across India and neighbouring countries, and spent thirteen years with Forbes & Co in product management and key accounts.

His credentials span both sides of the craft: an International Welding Engineer (IWE) diploma, ASNT NDT Level-II certification, and an M-Tech in Quality Management completed at BITS Pilani in his late forties — a career-long habit of learning that now shapes his next chapter: independent consulting, training and technical advisory work.

  • Based in Mumbai — India's industrial and energy capital, within reach of the country's major refinery, EPC and fabrication hubs.
  • Global remit — key-account responsibility spanning India and international petrochemical, chemical processing and power clients.
  • Still learning — M-Tech in Quality Management from BITS Pilani (2021–2023), earned alongside a full-time leadership role.

Expertise

Where the expertise sits

Deep welding science, the commercial judgement to apply it, and the quality systems to prove it — honed across oil & gas, refining, petrochemicals, power and steel.

Welding application engineering

Consumable selection, WPS/PQR qualification support, welding procedure development and weld failure analysis — matching filler metal and process to service conditions, from ambient to high-temperature creep duty.

Energy & process sectors

Oil & gas (upstream and downstream), petroleum refining, petrochemicals and chemical processing, thermal, nuclear and hydro power, steel mills and cross-country pipelines — the industries where a failed weld is never an option.

Quality, NDT & inspection

Welding QA/QC and non-destructive testing across RT, UT, MT and PT — building inspection regimes that catch defects before commissioning does, and quality management systems that hold up to audit.

Key accounts & product strategy

Global key account management, product management and business development — customer segmentation, Six Sigma discipline and SAP CRM-driven account planning for industrial brands selling into complex plants.

The Next Chapter

Consulting & advisory

Retirement from a title is not retirement from the craft. The same expertise, offered independently — for plants, projects and people who need it.

Thirty years of welding judgement, available by the engagement.

Refinery turnarounds, EPC fabrication, power-plant erection, welder training — the problems stay the same. What changes is who you can call. Advisory engagements are being shaped now, ahead of a full-time practice.

01

Welding engineering consultancy

WPS/PQR qualification, welding procedure development and consumable selection for critical service — getting the procedure right on paper before a single arc is struck, and troubleshooting when production welds misbehave.

02

QA/QC audits & failure analysis

Independent welding QA/QC audits and root-cause failure analysis for refineries, EPC contractors, power plants and fabricators — NDT-backed findings, corrective action, and systems that prevent the repeat.

03

Corporate training & welder upskilling

Structured programmes for welding teams: IWE-oriented engineering courses, welder upskilling and NDT awareness. India has a documented shortage of certified welding professionals — training is where thirty years compound fastest.

04

Owner's engineer & technical advisor

Owner-side technical oversight for large fabrication and energy projects: vendor qualification, procedure approval, inspection planning and the independent second opinion that keeps erection schedules and integrity intact.

05

Key-account & go-to-market advisory for industrial brands

For industrial and welding brands entering or scaling in India: account strategy, customer segmentation and the plant-floor credibility that opens doors in refining, petrochemicals and power. Few advisors have sold into these accounts for three decades — and run the technical side of them too.
